prompt: Who was the last Miss World America to place in the Top 11 at Miss World? Hint: She has pursued a modeling career.
answer: The last Miss World America to place specifically in the **Top 11** was **Audra Mari**, who represented the United States at Miss World 2016. She went on to pursue a career as a model and television host.
